about: Getting started, by hand, from a brand-new install (Rob 2026-11-08: "Film the by-hand setup"). Needs a dev server on an EMPTY database: delete its temp folder before starting it.

card.head: From a new install to your first plan.
card.sub: Getting started by hand. Every figure in this tour is made up.

scenes.say: Here's how Groundwork starts, from a brand-new install. Every figure in this tour is made up.

scenes.after: [...document.querySelectorAll('#obStepAICapability button')].find(b => /AI off/.test(b.textContent)).click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800));
scenes.say: First it checks what your computer can run. The AI works only on your computer, and every page works with it off.
Then choose how to begin: look around a sample household, bring in your bank's history, set things up by hand, or restore a backup.
Start with what comes in: your take-home pay, and how often you're paid.

scenes.do: const s = document.getElementById('obHomeState'); const o = [...s.options].find(o => o.text === 'Ohio'); s.value = o.value; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true}));
scenes.say: A few questions about your home. Each one can be skipped, and nothing is assumed in its place.
Then your regular bills. Ballpark figures are fine, and you can fine-tune them later on the Budget page.

scenes.do: const fill = (vals) => { const ins = [...document.querySelectorAll('#obDebtList input')].filter(e => e.offsetParent); const row = ins.slice(-4); row.forEach((e, k) => { e.value = vals[k]; e.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true})); }); }; if (![...document.querySelectorAll('#obDebtList input')].some(e => e.offsetParent)) obAddDebtRow(); fill(['Visa card', '3200', '22.9', '95']); obAddDebtRow(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); fill(['Car loan', '11400', '6.9', '310']);
scenes.say: Every card and loan, once: its balance, rate and minimum. It also shows what paying only the minimums would cost.
What would you like spare money to do? There's no wrong answer, and nothing here is locked in.
A net worth target is optional. It gives the plan a destination, if you'd like one.
And here's where you stand: the room in your month, your debts, and anything you skipped, so you know what's still unanswered.
From there, it's your Groundwork. Bring in a statement, or let Get my accounts fetch one, and every page fills in.

card.head: Start in a few minutes.
card.sub: Free for Windows, macOS and Linux · groundworkfinance.app

scenes.say: No account, no subscription, and nothing to sell you. Groundwork 2.0 is free.
